r304.description: The whole INT4 runtime rebased onto stock vLLM XPU v0.29.0. R301 = public vllm/vllm-openai-xpu@sha256:96db42e2 (v0.29.0, vllm-xpu-kernels 0.1.14.1 with upstream GDN fix #544) + the lineage's ten Python overlays ported as net diffs (draft INT4 head + R256 + R294 shortlist, R213b pad op, R224/R290-R293 class-pad, R156/R228/R276 GDN grouping, packed-serial-exact Gemma RMSNorm, FA/communicator/scaled_mm switches) + _xpu_C/GDN libraries rebuilt from kernels 6d92b1bf with oneDNN 0e2a5bfe + r137a + r137b + r221 (r35/r50 dropped: every serial-exact gate is 0 in the served configuration). R302 adds the vLLM PR #53059 uniform-decode alias guard; R303 adds the PR #51565 GDN first-chunk fix; R304 adds the PR #53542 active runtime-K width fix (dynamic draft schedules). Both fix failures that are LIVE on R294b: every one-token prompt and every (1+K)-token prompt at depth K degenerate into single-character walls (30/30). Serve with VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 (launchers pin it): v0.29.0 defaults XPU to the V2 runner, which bypasses the draft INT4 head.

2026-09-06: container records show the R257 headline pair (112.36/112.33 tok/s) ran the R228 image (aaf920b0…), not R256; R258, R259, R260b and R265b ran R256. The R256 overlay's fallback branch is never taken on this model (the relabelled lm_head is unquantized and already provides make_xpu_int4_draft_copy), so both images execute the same code on this lane and both are public on GHCR; the recipe text and matrix were corrected.

2026-09-06 (R278k): every runner-launched server ran with the R213b W4A16 determinism pad active above 128 rows (VLLM_XPU_W4A16_DETERMINISM_PAD absent from the container; the overlay defaults to on), because the launcher chain did not forward the variable. The single-user headline (5 verify rows), the strict gates, the identity ladders, and every rung through c16 (80 rows) are unaffected; the c32/c64 rungs of the published ladders (~360/~445 tok/s) were measured with 160/320 rows padded to 512 and are ~2x pessimistic.
